verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets users delegate generation and analysis tasks to its built-in AI (chat Q&A grounded in sources, generating study guides, audio/video overviews, quizzes, slide decks, mind maps) rather than requiring the user to do the work manually, which fits a lightweight notion of task delegation to an assistant. However, this is limited to content generation/summarization within the notebook — there's no evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution, external tool use, or agentic actions beyond producing artifacts from provided sources, and community feedback notes it can't search for sources on its own or take further autonomous action (e.g., it can't fetch new documents itself, per notebooklm-comm-4). Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step workflows, external action/tool invocation, or task execution beyond content transformation.
